test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 20 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

It is __us responsible__ for the current situation of the company.
solution:
The correct answer is '**we who are responsible**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**we who are responsible**" is grammatically correct and fits the context.
 
• The use of "we" is appropriate as it is the subject form of the pronoun, while "us" is the object form and does not fit in this sentence.
